text:
Type: large black round wall clock
Use: telling time on a wall; living room, kitchen, home office, dining room
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: slim black case with a raised rim, matte black face, white printed numerals and hands
Colors: black, white
Shape: plain round disc with a thin raised rim, large white numerals, dotted minute ring, slim white hands, flat and graphic, medium visual weight
Feel: graphic, bold, calm, modern
Goes with: white or light grey walls, black accents, light wood; monochrome, Scandinavian or modern rooms
